paper: OPERA: Towards Open Respiratory Acoustic Foundation Models: Pretraining and Benchmarking
datasets: COVID-19 Sounds; UK COVID-19; CoughVID; ICBHI; HF Lung; Coswara; KAUH; Respiratory@TR; SSBPR; MMlung; NoseMic
tasks: 19 downstream respiratory health tasks; binary/5-class classification and regression
label_harmonization: Dataset-specific tasks retained; not a single unified auscultation event label space
missing_label_policy: Not central in downstream protocol; no explicit respiratory event partial-label objective found
imbalance_method: Pretraining scale and foundation representation; no tail-specific RSC objective
OOD_protocol: Mostly frozen encoder + target linear probe; limited cross-domain linear-probe zero-shot T6->T9 and T7->T10
target_label_usage: Uses target train split labels for downstream linear probes; cross-domain examples train probe on source task and test target
per_class_evidence: Aggregate AUROC/MAE/MRR; no ICBHI/SPRSound event tail table found
metadata_use: Metadata exists in datasets but not central to first-stage linear probe claim
novelty_risk: Medium-high against broad respiratory FM benchmark claims
open_gap: Need OPERA as baseline; our gap must be auscultation event-label protocol and partial-label handling

paper: Lungmix: A Mixup-Based Strategy for Generalization in Respiratory Sound Classification
tasks: Four-class respiratory sound classification under source-domain and unseen-domain testing
label_harmonization: ICBHI four-class standard; SPR coarse/fine crackle -> crackle; stridor/rhonchus -> wheeze; HF lacks both
missing_label_policy: Unknown for HF both: paper says HF lacks both labels but does not specify masked vs negative handling
imbalance_method: Loudness/random-mask waveform mixup; semantic label interpolation by bitwise OR
OOD_protocol: Single-source DG across ICBHI/SPR/HF plus COMB; authors select best COMB tradeoff not best ICBHI
target_label_usage: No target labels for single-source target test implied; COMB-best selection boundary uses combined evaluation
per_class_evidence: Sp/Se on COMB; no crackle/wheeze/both per-class support/recall table found
metadata_use: Uses dataset labels; no metadata method
code: No complete official train/eval repo found
novelty_risk: High against simple cross-dataset DG/mixup framing
open_gap: Need explicit missing-label policy and per-class tail evidence; compare as baseline if using augmentation

paper: Resp-Agent: An Agent-Based System for Multimodal Respiratory Sound Generation and Disease Diagnosis
status: arXiv 2602.15909; arXiv says ICLR 2026 conference paper
datasets: UK COVID-19; ICBHI; SPRSound; COUGHVID; KAUH; HF Lung V1 for initialization only
tasks: ICBHI 4-class plus Resp-229k 16-class disease diagnosis and controllable generation
label_harmonization: Programmatically consolidates raw 20 disease classes to 16 diagnosis classes; not event-level crackle/wheeze harmonization
missing_label_policy: Not framed as partial event-label masking; disease labels assigned after taxonomy unification
imbalance_method: Generative class/domain balancing via Thinker-A2 CA; reports Macro-F1tail
OOD_protocol: Strict cross-domain Test-CD: train/val ICBHI+SPRSound+UK COVID-19, test KAUH+COUGHVID; LoSO across five sources
target_label_usage: Uses training-source labels; no target labels for Test-CD; also uses generation/planner within training setup
per_class_evidence: Macro-F1tail reported: no-synth 0.074, Thinker-A2 CA 0.421 at B=50k; ICBHI Score 72.70
metadata_use: Uses LLM-distilled clinical narratives and multimodal EHR/audio setup
novelty_risk: High against dataset aggregation and long-tail respiratory disease claims; medium for event-level audio-only work
open_gap: Different unit/task; need avoid claiming broad respiratory benchmark novelty

paper: Quality Adaptive Angular Margin Learning for Respiratory Sound Classification (QLung)
tasks: Four-class respiratory sound classification; ICBHI IND and SPRSound OOD
label_harmonization: SPRSound coarse/fine crackle -> crackle; stridor/rhonchi -> wheeze
missing_label_policy: No explicit partial-label/missing-label objective; SPR mapped to four classes
imbalance_method: No-reference audio quality margin plus log-scaled class-frequency angular margin
OOD_protocol: ICBHI IND / SPRSound OOD; table compares prior methods and QLung
target_label_usage: OOD numbers likely from source-trained models on SPRSound; exact selection/target-label use needs repo verification
per_class_evidence: Figure text gives normal +1, wheeze +6, both +5, crackle -8; no exact per-class table in text
open_gap: Need repo/selection verification and per-class support/confusion before using as fair comparator

paper: BTS-CARD: Empowering Multimodal Respiratory Sound Classification with Counterfactual Adversarial Debiasing for OOD Robustness
status: arXiv 2510.22263 v2; accepted ICASSP 2026; ICASSP program verified
label_harmonization: SPRSound seven labels mapped to four; crackle-related -> crackle; stridor/rhonchi -> wheeze
missing_label_policy: No partial-label objective; mapping collapses labels
imbalance_method: Counterfactual debiasing, adversarial debiasing, counterfactual metadata augmentation
OOD_protocol: ICBHI IND / SPRSound OOD using SPRSound inter-patient validation as OOD test
target_label_usage: Uses ICBHI labels for training; uses metadata labels for debiasing; no target-label tuning stated for OOD test
per_class_evidence: Aggregate Sp/Se/Score; no per-class tail table found
novelty_risk: High if our method uses metadata/device adapters; medium if audio-only
open_gap: Need compare/position metadata-free vs metadata-aware robustness

paper: PC-MCL: Patient-Consistent Multi-Cycle Learning with multi-label bias correction for respiratory sound classification
label_harmonization: Uses 3-label [normal, crackle, wheeze] multi-label then deterministic conversion to ICBHI four-class
missing_label_policy: Not cross-dataset; not a missing-label dataset objective
imbalance_method: Multi-cycle concatenation, explicit normal label, patient-matching auxiliary task
target_label_usage: Uses ICBHI train/test labels; no target domain
per_class_evidence: PR/AP for normal/crackle/wheeze; CE crackle AP 0.209/wheeze AP 0.116, full 0.642/0.663
metadata_use: Patient ID used in auxiliary matching
open_gap: Need adapt idea to heterogeneous datasets and unsupported labels

paper: Schutera et al. Methods for the frugal labeler: Multi-class semantic segmentation on heterogeneous labels
tasks: Multi-class semantic segmentation with heterogeneous/partial labels
label_harmonization: Class masks indicate present vs missing labels; not respiratory labels
missing_label_policy: Explicitly avoids treating missing labels as background by masking and class-asymmetric objective
imbalance_method: Not an imbalance method; partial-label objective
OOD_protocol: Heterogeneous-label training, transfer, merging datasets; not respiratory OOD
target_label_usage: Uses labels available per class mask; missing labels not treated as negatives
novelty_risk: Low direct risk; medium for partial-label objective idea
open_gap: Need respiratory adaptation because crackle/wheeze can co-occur and normal semantics differ

paper: Beyond Classification: A Cough Regression Benchmark for Respiratory Acoustic Foundation Models
status: arXiv 2606.15436; accepted ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Data for Health
tasks: Cough regression: age, BMI, X-ray abnormality probability, TB probability
label_harmonization: No auscultation event labels; regression targets per dataset
missing_label_policy: Not applicable to missing event labels
imbalance_method: No long-tail classification objective; evaluates FM embeddings and head capacity
OOD_protocol: Cross-dataset age transfer matrix; MLP-small trained on one dataset and evaluated on another without adaptation
target_label_usage: Uses target labels only for final test; within-dataset validation for early stopping
per_class_evidence: MAE/MAD and transfer gap; CoughVID->CIDRZ -0.17 yr, CIDRZ->Coswara +2.43 yr
metadata_use: No metadata shortcut method; labels are continuous targets
novelty_risk: Low direct risk; useful for transfer-asymmetry narrative
open_gap: Task boundary: cough regression, not lung-sound event classification
